# Housing supply and rent levels (fixture, distractor)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Completions of new dwellings fell relative to the previous year while asking rents rose
in the largest cities. The gap between supply and household formation widened. These
figures describe the housing market and contain no information about crime, migration or
working time.
